baselineDisplay.title: The Loss of the Titanic
baselineDisplay.question: What would have happened if only two of the sixteen watertight compartments had been flooded?
baselineDisplay.questionZh: 如果16个水密舱中只有两个进水，会发生什么？
baselineDisplay.text:
What would have happened if only two of the sixteen watertight compartments had been flooded?

Editorial note: This reading corrects the textbook using the 1912 British inquiry; the recording retains the original wording. The Titanic sailed for New York from Southampton on April 10th, 1912.
According to that inquiry, she carried 1,316 passengers and 885 crew when she left Queenstown the next day.
Her gross register tonnage was about 46,328, a measure of enclosed volume rather than weight.
At that time she was the largest ship in the world, and her sixteen watertight compartments inspired great confidence in her safety.
Even if any two of these were flooded, she would still have been able to float.
The tragic sinking of this great liner will always be remembered, for she went down on her first transatlantic voyage with heavy loss of life.
Four days after setting out, while the Titanic was sailing across the icy waters of the North Atlantic, a huge iceberg was suddenly spotted by a lookout.
After the alarm had been given, the ship began turning in an attempt to avoid the iceberg.
The turn was not enough: the iceberg struck the forward part of her starboard side.
The captain rushed to the bridge and asked what the ship had struck.
Although the collision did not at first seem alarming to everyone on board, the damage was serious.
The inquiry listed damage in six compartments; flooding the five foremost was already enough to sink the ship.
Evacuation followed, but many people were still aboard when the ship sank about two hours and forty minutes after the collision.
There was not enough lifeboat capacity for everyone, and some boats left partly empty. About 1,500 people lost their lives.

baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
编者注：本文依据1912年英国调查报告校正教材；录音保留原文。泰坦尼克号于1912年4月10日从南安普顿出发，驶向纽约。
据该调查报告，它次日离开昆士敦时载有1,316名乘客和885名船员。
它的登记总吨位约为46,328；这一数字计量的是封闭空间的容积，而不是重量。
它在当时是世界上最大的船，其16个水密舱使人们对它的安全性充满信心。
即使其中任意两个水密舱进水，它仍能够漂浮。
这艘巨型客轮的悲剧性沉没将永远被铭记，因为它在首次跨大西洋航行中沉没，造成了重大生命损失。
出发四天后，当泰坦尼克号正航行在北大西洋的冰冷水域时，瞭望员突然发现了一座巨大的冰山。
警报发出后，这艘船开始转向，试图避开冰山。
转向未能避免碰撞：冰山撞上了它右舷靠前的部分。
船长赶到驾驶台，询问船撞上了什么。
虽然船上并非所有人起初都觉得这次碰撞令人惊恐，但损伤十分严重。
调查报告列出了六个舱室的损伤；最前面的五个舱室进水就已足以使船沉没。
随后展开了撤离，但在碰撞约2小时40分钟后船只沉没时，仍有许多人留在船上。
救生艇的总容量不足以容纳所有人，而且有些艇未满载便离开了。约1,500人遇难。

display.title: The Loss of the Titanic
display.question: What'd have happened if only two of the 16 water-tight compartments had been flooded?
display.questionZh: 如果16个防水隔舱中只有两个进水，会发生什么？
display.text:
What'd have happened if only two of the 16 water-tight compartments had been flooded?

The great ship, Titanic sailed for New York from Southampton on April 10th, 1912.
She was carrying 1, 316 passengers and a crew of 891.
Even by modern standards, the 46, 000 ton Titanic was a colossal ship.
At that time, however, she was not only the largest ship that had ever been built, but was regarded as unsinkable, for she had sixteen water-tight compartments.
Even if two of these were flooded, she would still be able to float.
The tragic sinking of this great liner will always be remembered, for she went down on her first voyage with heavy loss of life.
Four days after setting out, while the Titanic was sailing across the icy waters of the North Atlantic, a huge iceberg was suddenly spotted by a lookout.
After the alarm had been given, the great ship turned sharply to avoid a direct collision.
The Titanic turned just in time, narrowly missing the immense wall of ice which rose over 100 feet out of the water beside her.
Suddenly, there was a slight trembling sound from below, and the captain went down to see what had happened.
The noise had been so faint that no one thought that the ship had been damaged.
Below, the captain realized to his horror that the Titanic was sinking rapidly, for five of her sixteen watertight compartments had already been flooded!
The order to abandon ship was given and hundreds of people plunged into the icy water.
As there were not enough life-boats for everybody, 1, 500 lives were lost.

She was carrying 1, 316 passengers and a crew of 891.

At that time, however, she was not only the largest ship that had ever been built, but was regarded as unsinkable, for she had sixteen water-tight compartments.
Even if two of these were flooded, she would still be able to float.
The tragic sinking of this great liner will always be remembered, for she went down on her first voyage with heavy loss of life.
Four days after setting out, while the Titanic was sailing across the icy waters of the North Atlantic, a huge iceberg was suddenly spotted by a lookout.
After the alarm had been given, the great ship turned sharply to avoid a direct collision.
The Titanic turned just in time, narrowly missing the immense wall of ice which rose over 100 feet out of the water beside her.
Suddenly, there was a slight trembling sound from below, and the captain went down to see what had happened.
The noise had been so faint that no one thought that the ship had been damaged.
Below, the captain realized to his horror that the Titanic was sinking rapidly, for five of her sixteen watertight compartments had already been flooded!

display.bodyTextZh:
这艘巨轮泰坦尼克号于1912年4月10日从南安普顿出发，驶向纽约。
船上载有1,316名乘客和891名船员。
即便以现代标准来看，这艘46,000吨的泰坦尼克号也是一艘巨轮。
然而在当时，它不仅是建造过的最大船只，而且被认为永不沉没，因为它有16个防水隔舱。
即使其中两个隔舱进水，它仍然能够漂浮。
这艘巨轮的悲剧性沉没将永远被人们铭记，因为它在首航中沉没，造成了重大生命损失。
出发四天后，当泰坦尼克号正航行在北大西洋的冰冷水域时，瞭望员突然发现了一座巨大的冰山。
警报发出后，这艘巨轮急转弯以避免直接相撞。
泰坦尼克号及时转向，勉强避开了那座高出水面100英尺的巨大冰墙。
突然，从船底传来一阵轻微的颤动声，船长走下船舱去看发生了什么事。
声音非常微弱，以至于没人认为船体受损了。
在船舱里，船长惊恐地发现泰坦尼克号正在迅速下沉，因为它的16个防水隔舱中已经有5个进水了！
弃船命令下达后，数百人跳入冰冷的海水中。
由于救生艇的数量不足以容纳所有人，因此有 1,500 人失去了生命。

警报发出后，这艘巨轮急转弯以避免直接相撞。
泰坦尼克号及时转向，勉强避开了那座高出水面100英尺的巨大冰墙。
突然，从船底传来一阵轻微的颤动声，船长走下船舱去看发生了什么事。
声音非常微弱，以至于没人认为船体受损了。
在船舱里，船长惊恐地发现泰坦尼克号正在迅速下沉，因为它的16个防水隔舱中已经有5个进水了！
弃船命令下达后，数百人跳入冰冷的海水中。
由于救生艇的数量不足以容纳所有人，因此有 1,500 人失去了生命。
